name: Chance It!
source:
All she wanted to do was get some sleep…

Del's night was already ruined by the stack of paperwork her boss dumped on her last minute. If that wasn't bad enough, things take a bizarre turn when she meets a guy that keeps throwing dice in order to make decisions and a gun-wielding shota that can't talk. 

[From [url=https://tofu-sheets-visual.itch.io/chance-it]Itch.io[/url]]
